question: Will GPT 6 be released by September 15th?
resolution_criteria:
This market resolves yes if a model called GPT-6, or any variant thereof (gpt-6 sol, gpt-6 codex, gpt 6.1, etc) is released by OpenAI by September 15th 11:59 pm ET. A model is considered released if it's available to the public via the API, via the chatgpt app or website, or via codex. It resolves no otherwise. 

I may trade on this market.
research:
I've limited this to material dated on or before 2026-09-01. Several search results were dated after that, so I left them out completely. All direct page fetches failed with proxy errors, so the facts below come from search-result summaries and could not be checked against the full articles.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question doesn't name a URL. In practice, OpenAI's own channels decide it: its announcements, the API model list, ChatGPT and Codex availability, and its deployment safety hub (system cards).
- 2026-09-01: I found no pre-cutoff OpenAI announcement of a model called "GPT-6" or any variant that the public can use.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. As of the latest pre-cutoff reporting I found, OpenAI's next frontier model, codenamed "Astra", was being held back for safety review. OpenAI had not given a release date, and it had not confirmed that Astra would be called "GPT-6".
- 2026-07-09: GPT-5.6 Sol launched publicly and was OpenAI's flagship at the time of late-July reporting. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/prediction-markets-price-gpt-6-public-release-by-sept-30-at-78)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-10: Axios and CNBC reported that OpenAI was holding back Astra after it reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold" in safety testing, and was pausing some internal Astra work. In the same week OpenAI expanded its Daybreak cybersecurity program into Blue and Red access tiers, with GPT-5.6-Cyber for Red partners. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/08/10/openai-gpt-astra-restrictions-safety-hacking-defenders), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/10/open-ai-daybreak-cybersecurity.html), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2234335/openai-daybreak-model-less-likely-to-refuse-higher-risk-tasks/)
- 2026-08-08 (approx.): Altman reportedly gave no specific timeline for Astra, saying only "hopefully not too long" and citing extra safety review of its cyber capabilities. [NationPress](https://www.nationpress.com/sciencetech/sam-altman-openais-astra-model-coming-soon-cyber-safety-needs-more-time)
- 2026-08-07 (approx.): OpenAI reportedly slowed Astra's release to add safeguards. One secondary summary links this to incidents in July 2026 where AI agents accessed systems they shouldn't have.
- Undated, pre-cutoff: A Manifold market notes reports that OpenAI was undecided whether Astra would ship as GPT-6 or as another GPT-5.x, such as GPT-5.7. This naming question matters a lot for how the market resolves. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/event/will-gpt-6-be-released-by-september)
- Earlier: Altman reportedly demoed Astra on Capitol Hill, and older reporting said OpenAI planned to release Astra by the end of 2026. [BigGo](https://finance.biggo.com/news/991763e3-7527-49a1-8c1d-bab99af1df55), [Geeky Gadgets](https://www.geeky-gadgets.com/openai-agi-astra-release-timeline/)

## 4. Base rates
- OpenAI shipped GPT-5.x point releases roughly every 1 to 3 months through 2025 and 2026, ending with GPT-5.6 Sol on 2026-07-09. The gap from GPT-4 (March 2023) to GPT-5 (August 2025) was about 29 months.
- Recent major launches have often gone to the public within a day of being announced, or after a brief limited preview. So if a GPT-6-branded model is announced before September 15, it could plausibly count as "released" quickly. Gated programs like Daybreak might not count.
- Market history: the Polymarket "GPT-6 by March 31, 2026" market resolved No. [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/573826)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-15: Polymarket's "GPT-6 released by September 15, 2026" was at about 21% Yes. [Orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/will-gpt-6-be-released-by-september-15-2026)
- Late July 2026: Polymarket's "by September 30" market was at about 77-78%. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/prediction-markets-price-gpt-6-public-release-by-sept-30-at-78), [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/gpt-6-released-by-september-30-2026-polymarket-0xf82f84686e)
- Decrypt reported that Polymarket and Myriad traders expected GPT-6 in September 2026. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/374472/openai-gpt-6-will-arrive-september-prediction-market)
- Polymarket's rules require public access, and closed betas don't count. That is close to this question's criteria.
- I couldn't get prices from around September 1, or any Kalshi prices.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An OpenAI announcement of Astra and what it is called. The key uncertainty is whether it ships under the GPT-6 name or as GPT-5.7.
- Whether the first rollout is gated (for example, Daybreak partners only) or public through the API, ChatGPT or Codex. Only public availability counts here.
- A system card being posted on OpenAI's deployment safety hub, which usually comes right before or with a release.
- More statements from Altman or OpenAI about the cyber-safety review being finished.
